note:
Re-acquisition of the 30B MoE arm. The earlier P2 numbers were reported without any
of these cells having run, so nothing from that table is reused here; these are the first
actual measurements of KV quantisation on the MoE.

The MoE-specific question: the router picks top-k discretely, so if rollout and trainer
numerics differ slightly the selected expert set can flip for some tokens. A flipped set
is not a small perturbation of the logprob, so the smooth "quantisation precision ->
mismatch" relation seen on dense models could break. mis_chi2_token is recorded alongside
mis_kl because a minority of flipped tokens would show up in the tail long before it moved
the mean.

30B needs all 16 GPU behind the actor plus --use-distributed-optimizer (H200's 141GB
cannot hold the static memory otherwise), so cells run strictly one at a time and this arm
is the reason two nodes are needed.

Step 0 only (NUM_ROLLOUT=1): no optimizer step, so the numerical-path gap is measured on
its own.

cells.name: 30b_bf16
cells.note: Baseline: no KV quantisation. The value the two fp8 cells are amplified from.

cells.name: 30b_e5m2
cells.note: KV cache in fp8_e5m2: fewer mantissa bits, so the coarser of the two.
